correctness.rationale: The 16 Q4 vertices with inclusive pairwise Hamming distances <=2 give 392 nonempty simplices and 196 orbit cells. Antipodes never share an edge, so the geometric involution has a regular orbit-CW structure. The eight even-parity vertices form the boundary of the four-dimensional cross-polytope; its antipodal quotient is RP^3. Independently reconstructed and validated the 76 exact relative face/coface pairs from matching.json, all 600 orbit Hasse incidences, acyclic reversed Hasse digraph, and exactly four critical dimension-3 orbit cells outside RP^3. Relative Forman reduction attaches four 3-cells to RP^3. Their S^2 attaching maps are null because pi_2(RP^3)=pi_2(S^3)=0, hence RP^3 wedge four S^3; the claimed integral homology and fundamental group follow. This finite exhaustive certificate proves only Q4 at scale two.
